name: Cinema Project
description: Loads the Cinema Project script into Jellyfin Web.
overview: Automatic loader for the Cinema Project userscript.

versions.changelog: Fixed a plugin load-order race: registration with 'File Transformation' now retries in the background (up to 5 attempts, 3s apart) instead of only once synchronously in the constructor, since 'File Transformation' may not have finished its own internal setup yet at that point (alphabetical load order puts 'Cinema Project' first). Also reduced log verbosity for intermediate retry attempts.

Rebuilt from a clean, verified commit (v1.0.4's release accidentally shipped a stale pre-fix binary despite the correct source being on main). Tag name now always matches the internal assembly version going forward.

Fixed 'File Transformation' registration -- it requires a real Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject, not a plain C# object (this was the actual reason the script injection never happened despite the plugin loading successfully).
Fixed version showing as 0.0.0.0 in My Plugins. Renamed to 'Cinema Project'. Shortened description.
Corrected targetAbi and Jellyfin.Controller package version to match Jellyfin 10.10.7.
